disclosures.title: replacement copy, not a shortcut
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells a Zenistar Blueprint for 100,000 standing, but only after you've claimed it from Daily Tribute. It builds for 30,000 credits, 4 Morphics, 450 Circuits, 500 Polymer Bundle and 2,750 Salvage over a day, and gives no extra Mastery.
